text: Security is essential in web development. When you build a website, you must protect both your users and your data. First, always use HTTPS to encrypt communication between the browser and the server. This keeps sensitive information safe from attackers. Second, use strong authentication so only the right people can access accounts. Third, validate all user input to prevent harmful code from entering your system. Common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, often happen when developers ignore these steps. By following good security practices, you can reduce risks and build safer, more trustworthy websites for everyone.
